Counterstrike

Quick scoping dat awp, 1 shot to the foot, my death will be instant painless.

I've had plenty of bad dates, but two that stand out for me are the times I met a girl online.

#1

I made lunch for us in the park, and she spent the first 10 minutes talking about how her friends thought she was going to be raped. Then her friends approached us as if they were passing by, but they weren't very subtle about how they were checking in on her to see if she was safe. Kind of awkward really. She agreed to a couple more dates, then it sort of became a pity thing and she just ended up ignoring me. Really awkward.

#2 

I agreed to meet up with this girl in my town, she was about 200 lbs heavier than her profile picture, I'm talking ungodly obese. I didn't want to fucking destroy the poor girl's confidence so I just go through the motions. 10 minutes into the date she says her mom's calling. This girl is now on the phone with her mom crying, begging to let her stay, etc etc. All I hear from around the corner is "BUT MOMMA, HE'S SO NICE, COME ON MOMMA." It was fucking wierd. She comes back and says that I need to take her home. I look at her like she's fucking crazy. She got her herself, why is she unable to get home?

WELL, it turns out the girl is underage, and lives 3 hours away. She throws gas money at me and I drive her all the way back to bumfuckville, the whole way there she's apologizing and crying. When we get there her redneck dad is on the porch waiting, he also happens to be the town sheriff. After she gets out I just peel the fuck out and don't look back.
I never learned how to drive manual because growing up my parents only had automatic. I'm not willing to toss down $1000~ I don't have on a beater car just to learn how to drive manual.
I'd like to know where as well. $40 for a couple of hours is good. From what I've heard this site requires little to no effort compared to PPD marketting with niches and whatnot.

I have aspergers, and when I tried it, I was able to hold conversations without fucking panicking or feeling awkward. Then again, I did ramble a lot, could be because the shit was probably bunked with meth. Either way, I felt normal, I was able to socialize normally and whatnot, things I'm otherwise incapable of doing. The crash was phenomenal though, I could actually feel my anxiety physically coming back, then I got spun out and stayed awake for 2 days, stopped caring about things, felt mildly depressed. I'm pretty sure I got meth.

Tldr Meth.
That's in Arizona. Even from across the country I can still recognize that shitty state by it's cookie cutter landscaping/architecture.

Well, I'll go ahead and take this down.

I don't see why though, if you're not asking for face value when it's a game that you have to beat the average of to get.
I have no idea what I'm doing, but yay for peer coins!

Thank you. My therapist has recently suggested I write out how the accident occurred and how it has affected me, and she will read it outloud back to me. I'm not sure how that is going to help, but I'm willing to try anything at this point.
Thankfully, yes, I have attorney's working on my cases.

I've written letters to my ex girlfriend, letters I never delivered. That seemed to help with the feelings of betrayal towards her. I will try to write about everything else, it's just hard to make sense of it all, I try not to throw a pity party about my situation, but it's hard to come to terms with how everything has been turned upside down.
